# Test fixtures

Generated by scripts, so anyone can rebuild them. Do not edit the PDFs or `coords.json` by hand.

```bash
# from the bench directory
env/bin/python apps/frappe_sign/frappe_sign/tests/fixtures/scripts/make_pdfs.py     # PDFs and coords.json
env/bin/python apps/frappe_sign/frappe_sign/tests/fixtures/scripts/check_coords.py  # coords.json vs pdfium
env/bin/python apps/frappe_sign/frappe_sign/tests/fixtures/scripts/make_certs.py    # certs/
```

The output is deterministic, except `pdfs/encrypted.pdf` (random encryption salt) and the certificate keys. `tests/unit/test_fixtures.py` regenerates the PDFs in a temporary directory and compares page boxes, rotation, text and encryption with the committed files.

## PDFs (`pdfs/`)

| File | What it is | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a4_simple.pdf` | A4 portrait (595.28 x 841.89 pt), no rotation, CropBox = MediaBox | Coordinate baseline |
| `letter_simple.pdf` | US Letter portrait (612 x 792 pt) | Non-A4 page size |
| `rotated_90.pdf` | A4 page with `/Rotate 90`, so it shows landscape | Rotation in coordinate conversion |
| `offset_cropbox.pdf` | A4 MediaBox, CropBox `[40 60 520 780]` | CropBox offset from the origin |
| `rotated_270_cropbox.pdf` | US Letter, `/Rotate 270` and CropBox `[36 48 576 744]` | Rotation and CropBox offset together |
| `scanned_image.pdf` | One page that is only a raster image, no text layer | Overlay on scans; anchors find nothing |
| `many_pages_150.pdf` | 150 A4 pages with "Page N of 150" | Page caps, memory, lazy page rendering |
| `encrypted.pdf` | AES-256, user password `fixture-user`, owner password `fixture-owner` | Sanitize rejects encrypted PDFs |
| `with_javascript.pdf` | Document JavaScript (`/Names /JavaScript`), `/OpenAction`, a page `/AA` action, an embedded file and an AcroForm text field | Sanitize strips all of them |
| `arabic_text.pdf` | Latin title plus three Arabic lines, shaped with arabic-reshaper and python-bidi, drawn in the embedded Noto Naskh Arabic | Arabic extraction and overlay next to Arabic content |

Each of the five geometric fixtures has three filled boxes (red, green, blue) at the rects listed in `coords.json`.

## `coords.json`

For each geometric fixture: the page boxes, rotation and displayed size, and three cases. A case gives a normalized rect (`x, y, w, h` in 0..1, top-left origin, relative to the visible page after CropBox and `/Rotate`, D7) and the PDF user space rect `[llx, lly, urx, ury]` it must convert to. The Python tests (P1.1) and the Vitest tests for `shared/coords.ts` (P1.15) both use this file.

The expected values do not come from the code under test. `check_coords.py` renders each fixture with pdfium, which applies CropBox and rotation itself, finds each coloured box and checks that it sits at the case's normalized rect, within one point.

## Certificates (`certs/`)

A self-signed test CA, sealing certificates and a TSA certificate. See `certs/README.md`; the `.p12` password is `fixture-seal`.

## Fonts

`arabic_text.pdf` uses `frappe_sign/pdf/fonts/NotoNaskhArabic-Regular.ttf` (SIL Open Font License, see `OFL-NotoNaskhArabic.txt` next to it).
